title: docs(adr): ADR-0048 §5 describes the namespace-prefix lint as it now ships

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:只改 ADR-0048 §5 的一条 lint 说明，让它与已发布的 `naming/namespace-prefix` 一致。
- **为什么改**:原条目还写着「只查 7 类、只豁免同名 app 和 `sys_`」;#30842 与 #30927 合并后已不是这样。
- **风险与回滚**:纯文档，不发布任何包(`skip-changeset`)。回滚即 revert。
- **先看**:`docs/adr/0048-cross-package-metadata-collision.md` 的 §5 第一条。
- **两分钟验证**:对照 `packages/cli/src/commands/lint.ts` 的 `NAME_JUDGED_ELSEWHERE`、`carriesPackageNamespace` 和 `PLATFORM_REQUESTED_BARE_NAMES` 读一遍新条目。
- **需要你做的**:这是 `docs/adr` 的 Tier H 改动，需要 os-zhuang 或 hotlong 批准后合并。

## What changes

ADR-0048 §5's first bullet described the old `naming/namespace-prefix`: a warning on seven types (`app`, `page`, `dashboard`, `flow`, `action`, `report`, `dataset`) that exempted only the namespace-named app and `sys_` names. It now describes the rule as it ships after #30842 and #30927:

- it warns on every bare package-authored top-level name in every manifest collection, and gives the rename as its `fix`;
- it leaves objects (`defineStack` refuses those), views, docs (`docs/namespace-prefix`), extensions, translation bundles, fields, `functions` and `overrides` items to other checks;
- a name carries the namespace when it is the namespace itself (ADR-0019), starts with `<ns>_`, is a `<ns>.<short>` capability name, or starts with `sys_`;
- the permission set `guest_portal` is exempt, because the public form doors request it by that bare name (ADR-0138), and the exemption is named `PLATFORM_REQUESTED_BARE_NAMES`;
- it still reports a name declared twice in one package, it is warning-only, and the refusal is phase 3 (#30806).

The bullet links both maintainer rulings it rests on:

- dotted capability names carry the namespace, 2026-11-06T11:08Z, recorded in [#30804 comment 6683456244](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/30804#issuecomment-6683456244);
- `guest_portal` is exempt, 2026-11-06T14:57Z, recorded in [#30804 comment 6687835712](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/30804#issuecomment-6687835712).

No other line of the ADR changes. Its status, decision and addenda are untouched.

## Why

Ruling C on #30798 (maintainer, verbatim 「同意 c」): every package-authored metadata name carries its namespace, phased. Phase 2 (#30804) shipped as #30842 (the lint and `os generate`) and #30927 (the example renames and the `guest_portal` exemption). This one-file PR brings the ADR's phasing list in line and closes the card.

## Acceptance notes

- **Tier H.** This touches `docs/adr/**`, so it needs a governed approver (os-zhuang or hotlong). Auto-merge is not armed.
- **Changeset:** none. It is a docs-only PR and releases nothing, so it carries the `skip-changeset` label.
- **Two other sentences in the ADR mention the rule and stay as written.** §3.4 item 4 (the `os lint` rule "keeps authoring hygiene") and the paragraph after it (a package shipping two `page/home` items "stays covered by the `naming/namespace-prefix` lint") are both still true.
